P.name: Absolution
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Weakened Soul}}: '''Senna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|abilities}} mark enemy champions hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent attacks or ability hits against marked targets will consume the mark to grant '''Senna''' a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|Mist}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1 to 10 for 10|formula=1% * level, capped at level 10|key=%}} of the target's '''current''' health}}, rendering the target immune to being marked again for a few seconds. This damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Enemies that die near '''Senna''' may spawn a ''Mist Wraith'' from their corpse. A ''Mist Wraith'' lasts 8 seconds and '''Senna''' can basic attack or hit it with ''{{ai|Piercing Darkness|Senna}}'' or ''{{ai|Dawning Shadow|Senna}}'' to kill it instantly, granting her {{g|8}} and a stack of {{as|Mist}}.
* Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} will spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Epic {{tip|monsters}} will spawn 2 ''Mist Wraiths''.
* {{tip|Minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' kills have a 5% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
* Large {{tip|minions}} that '''Senna''' does not kill will always spawn a ''Mist Wraith'', while lesser {{tip|minions}} and lesser {{tip|monsters}} that '''Senna''' does not kill have a 32% chance to spawn one.
* Lesser minions executed by an allied champion's {{nie|Support Quest}} item have a {{fd|8.4}}% chance to spawn a ''Mist Wraith''.
P.description3: {{sbc|Mist}}: For each stack of {{as|Mist}}, '''Senna''' gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|{{fd|0.75}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}. For every 20 stacks, she also gains {{sti|attack range|20 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{sti|critical strike chance|{{as|10% critical strike chance}}}}. Additionally, every {{tt|{{as|1% critical strike chance}}|Counts critical strike chance from items and Mist stacks}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{fd|0.35}}% {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
P.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Relic Cannon}}: '''Senna's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|20% AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and grant her {{as|{{pp|key=%|10 to 20 for 3|1;6;9}} of the target's movement speed|ms}} as {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The damage {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.

Q.name: Piercing Darkness
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a beam in the direction of the target unit. The beam consists of a wider ray of light, and a narrower ray of shadow at the center.

The shadow ray deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 15% {{as|(+ 15% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} for a duration. The damage dealt to enemy champions {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}
Q.description2: The light ray {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Senna''' and allied {{tip|champions}} hit.
Q.description3: ''Piercing Darkness'' is {{tt|considered|Piercing Darkness doesn't actually apply basic damage}} to trigger a single {{tip|basic attack}} against {{tip|turrets}}, {{tip|wards}}, [[jungle plants]], {{ai|Absolution 3|Senna|Mist Wraiths}} and [[Champion_summoned_units#Targetable|any other attack-interactive units]] hit. It also applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|turrets}} hit, and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects against {{tt|one champion hit|see notes}}.
Q.description4: ''Piercing Darkness' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 1 second {{tip|on-attack}}.
Q.cast time: {{as|80% of '''Senna's''' windup time|as}} ({{fd|{{#expr:0.8*{{ccd|Senna|windup}}*(1/{{ccd|Senna|as_base}})round2}}}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})

W.name: Last Embrace
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' throws a globule of Black Mist in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and attaches to them for 1 second.
W.description2: After the duration or when the target dies, the Black Mist spreads out of the target, {{tip|root|rooting}} them and surrounding enemies for a few seconds.

E.name: Curse of the Black Mist
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' shrouds herself in an {{tip|aura}} of Black Mist and gains {{tip|camouflage}} for a duration. If '''Senna''' {{tip|breaks stealth|breaks the camouflage}}, she regains it after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth.
E.description2: Allied champions who enter the mist gain ''Wraith Form'' for a duration equal to the aura's remaining duration.
E.description3: {{sbc|Wraith Form:}} Gain {{tip|camouflage}}. Enemies are granted {{tip|obscured vision}} of camouflaged ''Wraiths'' moving outside the mist within their line of {{tip|sight}}. ''Wraith Form'' can be regained if lost by breaking the camouflage after {{fd|1.75}} seconds without performing actions that break stealth. ''Wraith Form'' ends immediately upon '''Senna's''' {{tip|death}}.
E.description4: '''Senna''' and allies camouflaged by ''Curse of the Black Mist'' also gain {{sti|ms|{{as|20%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
E.description5: '''''Senna''' can move during Curse of the Black Mist's cast time.''

R.name: Dawning Shadow
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a massive beam in the target direction. The beam consists of a broad wave of light, and a narrow wave of shadow at the center.
R.description2: The shadow wave deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 3 seconds, as well as hits all ''{{ai|Absolution|Senna|Mist Wraiths}}''.
R.description3: The light wave grants a {{tip|shield}} to '''Senna''' and allied champions hit for 3 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of {{tt|the area|Can see through brush and terrain.}} along the path for 2 seconds.
